<h1 style="text-align: center; font-weight: bold;">Welcome, here are some projects of mine</h1>

### [Economics at The New School](tnse.html)

A three-part institutional and intellectual history of The New School's
economics department — who taught there, what they argued, and how the
department changed American economics. A 121-page draft of Part 1 is available
on request.

<h2 style="text-align: center; border-bottom: 1px solid; padding-bottom: 0.35rem; opacity: 0.9;">The Heterodata suite</h2>

The Heterodata suite is built **agent-first**: an AI-driven research workflow
designs, constructs, and documents every site, and every number on them traces
to a documented source. The interactive demos are self-hosted; I am migrating
the server right now, so they are all temporarily offline. The **source code for
every project is on GitHub** and linked below, so the work is always viewable.

**Interactive demos**

- **Foodberg** *(demo temporarily offline — [code on GitHub](https://github.com/andenick/Foodberg))* — global food and commodity price explorer.
- **HMDA Explore** *(demo temporarily offline — [code on GitHub](https://github.com/andenick/hmda-analysis))* — a dashboard over Home Mortgage Disclosure Act data on U.S. mortgage lending.
- **JJ Muni** *(demo temporarily offline — [code on GitHub](https://github.com/andenick/westchester))* — Westchester County sidewalk-coverage web map, tract by tract.
- **NYC Visualizer** *(demo temporarily offline — [code on GitHub](https://github.com/andenick/nycvisualizer))* — live New York City transit map and sidewalk accessibility.
- **Gerhard** *(demo temporarily offline — [code on GitHub](https://github.com/andenick/gerhard))* — the history and present of American public finance: taxation, spending, and debt over time.
- **Shaikh Data** *(demo temporarily offline — [code on GitHub](https://github.com/andenick/shaikh-capitalism-data))* — replications of Anwar Shaikh's *Capitalism* and *Measuring the Wealth of Nations*, with interactive charts, downloads, and full provenance.
- **Lewis** *(demo temporarily offline — [code on GitHub](https://github.com/andenick/lewis))* — international economics: balance-of-payments and cross-border value transfers across the world's economies.
- **Leontief** *(demo temporarily offline — [code on GitHub](https://github.com/andenick/leontief))* — U.S. input–output accounts; compute and inspect the Leontief inverse across sectors.
- **Vlad** *(demo temporarily offline — [code on GitHub](https://github.com/andenick/vlad-web))* — the official statistics of the Soviet Union and Imperial Russia.
- **Myrdal** *(demo temporarily offline — [code on GitHub](https://github.com/andenick/myrdal-web))* — population as a cause of economic outcomes: the long-run demographic transition.
- **Race** *(demo temporarily offline — [code on GitHub](https://github.com/andenick/race-web))* — race, stratification, and economic disparities in the United States.
- **Gordon** *(demo temporarily offline — [code on GitHub](https://github.com/andenick/gordon-web))* — U.S. employment and inflation on BLS, BEA, and Federal Reserve primary data.
- **Erwin** *(demo temporarily offline — [code on GitHub](https://github.com/andenick/erwin-web))* — military spending as an endogenous feature of capitalism.
- **FreeNIC** *(demo temporarily offline — [code on GitHub](https://github.com/andenick/FreeNIC))* — bank-level U.S. financial-data explorer: failures, FRED series, and active institutions; bulk data free.
- **Methodex** *(demo temporarily offline — [code on GitHub](https://github.com/andenick/methodex-web))* — a public-domain economic-statistics methodology layer.

**Source code (GitHub)** — every project's code, always available:
[Gerhard](https://github.com/andenick/gerhard) · [Shaikh Data](https://github.com/andenick/shaikh-capitalism-data) · [Lewis](https://github.com/andenick/lewis) · [Leontief](https://github.com/andenick/leontief) · [Vlad](https://github.com/andenick/vlad-web) · [Myrdal](https://github.com/andenick/myrdal-web) · [Race](https://github.com/andenick/race-web) · [Gordon](https://github.com/andenick/gordon-web) · [Erwin](https://github.com/andenick/erwin-web) · [FreeNIC](https://github.com/andenick/FreeNIC) · [Foodberg](https://github.com/andenick/Foodberg) · [HMDA Explore](https://github.com/andenick/hmda-analysis) · [Methodex](https://github.com/andenick/methodex-web) · [JJ Muni](https://github.com/andenick/westchester) · [NYC Visualizer](https://github.com/andenick/nycvisualizer).

The hub (heterodata.org) and the data downloads (files.heterodata.org) are temporarily offline during the migration.
